after: turning-points.md: violent turns (DISPLACE_C, BREACH_REVERT, DELIVERY_SHIFT the turn's way; a range shock in the top decile) mark major turns beyond walks, but entering at the turn trades like a walk
question: does the origin of a violent turn, marked as a zone, hold on the first return better than the origin of an ordinary low, and better than walks
origin: a 12-bar low knowable at bar t (lowest low of t-2..t at or below the lowest of t-11..t-3); the zone is [bottom, bottom + 0.5 ATR(t)] with bottom = that 3-bar low. Highs are the same on the flipped chart

families.SIG: bar t completes DISPLACE_C, BREACH_REVERT or DELIVERY_SHIFT up (MCFL v1, known_at = t)
families.RZ: bar t's range_z (range against the mean and sd of the 10 ranges before it) at or above the MT5 VIOLENT threshold for its timeframe from violence.py: 1h 3.109, 4h 2.699, 1d 2.022

activation.proven (primary): price rallies 3 ATR(t) above the bottom before trading below it, within 60 bars; the zone is live from the bar after the rally completes
activation.left: price trades 1.5 ATR(t) above the bottom before trading below it, within 60 bars; live from the bar after

entry: the first bar, within 20 days of going live, whose low reaches the zone top: a limit buy at the top (at the open if the bar opens below it); one trade per zone, its first return only
stop: bottom - 0.1 ATR(t); any stop fill takes 0.05 ATR(t) of adverse slippage; a stop touched on the fill bar is a loss

exits.E1 (primary): a 2-ATR(t) trail behind the best high of completed bars after the fill bar
exits.X2: a fixed 2R target; on the fill bar it counts only if the bar closes at or beyond it

R: against the nominal risk top - stop, net of costs (Binance 0.07% of price; MT5 the broker's spread floor; walks the real series' cost in ATR units at the same bar)
nulls: iid walk matched to each series (mcfl.synth.matched_walk)
GARCH(1,1) walk with the series' sigma (volatility clusters, direction does not)
both with 256 sub-steps a bar and the real timestamps
also: P(N R) for N in 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 10 (the most R reached before the exit) against 1/(N+1); MT5 reported, never pooled into the primary
data: Binance perpetuals (12 coins) and MT5 (10 markets), 1h, 4h, 1d
passes_if: R > 0 with day-bootstrap 90% interval above 0, positive before and after 2024-01-01, above ALL proven E1 on the same data, and above the same cell on both walks
